appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads 'Cooling Water Temperature Compliance' in large bold black text.
A single blue line connects ten black circular data points, showing a general downward trend from left to right.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Cooling water temperature' and has tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for every year from 2005 to 2014.
Each data point has a specific temperature value annotated directly above it in black text.
The line is flat between 2005 and 2006, indicating no change in temperature.
The line shows a consistent decline in temperature from 2007 through 2014.
The graph starts at a high point (23.9°C) and ends at a low point (10.1°C), indicating a significant decrease over the decade.

public_definitions: Review the cooling water temperature dashboard for the 2005-2014 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period cooling water temperature change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
uncertain: The specific threshold for 'substantial change' is not defined in the chart or text.
It is unclear if a decrease in temperature is considered a 'change' requiring follow-up in the same way an increase would be, though the magnitude is large.
